title: How to probe lattice dynamics using tandem Fabry–Pérot Brillouin spectroscopy
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 10 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00961-6

Furqanul Hassan Naqvi explains how careful Brillouin spectroscopy can provide insight into lattice dynamics beyond determining elastic constants.

title: The costs and benefits of physics research
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 09 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00958-1

Deciding what physics research to pursue involves cost–benefit analysis — which should include environmental impacts.

title: Atomic force microscopy from nanoscale imaging to holistic exploration
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 04 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00956-3

Forty years after its invention, atomic force microscopy has evolved from a simple surface imaging tool into one of the most versatile measurement platforms in nanoscience. This Comment traces the key innovations.

title: Exploring decolonizing the curriculum using Six Thinking Hats
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 04 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00959-0

Decolonizing physics is a scientific necessity often stalled by ‘competence anxiety’. By using the Six Thinking Hats framework, educators can navigate these challenging conversations with structure and safety.

title: Do the benefits of fundamental physics research outweigh its wider societal costs?
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 27 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00951-8

Deciding whether a big science project is sustainable is a complex multi-dimensional problem, but there are tools from economics that can help with decision making.

title: Transparent conducting electrodes for perovskite–silicon tandem solar cells
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 27 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00938-5

Transparent conducting electrodes are a key performance and sustainability bottleneck in high-efficiency perovskite–silicon tandem solar cells. This Review examines how optical, electrical and interfacial losses in transparent conducting electrodes arise in tandem cells and outlines strategies to enable scalable, low-indium electrodes for next-generation devices.

title: Transitions of the Atlantic Ocean circulation
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 18 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00945-6

The multistable dynamics of the Atlantic Ocean circulation pose a central problem in climate physics, because instabilities of the flows can have large climate impacts. This Review uses a dynamical systems viewpoint to unify results obtained from a hierarchy of ocean-climate models.

title: Chaotic photonics in microresonators
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 15 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00941-w

Chaos in photonics is not always a nuisance but often a source of innovation. This Review surveys chaotic microcavity photonics across materials and architectures, highlighting opportunities to harness chaotic dynamics for technology and science.
